description: Book an apartment for the guest. No credit card is needed when paying at the property (stays above the deposit limit return a link for a small card deposit that must be paid within 1 hour). Only call this after check_availability, and after the guest has confirmed the apartment, dates, number of guests, total price and their own name, email and phone. The guest receives a confirmation email.

apartment.description: Apartment name exactly as returned by list_apartments / check_availability

guest_email.description: Guest's email — the confirmation is sent here

guest_phone.description: Guest's phone number, with country code

special_requests.description: Optional: arrival time, pets, cot, other requests

name: book_stay
title: Book a stay
